assets.name: Main Gate
assets.description: Main campus entry checkpoint for vehicles and pedestrians with solar-powered boundary lights.

assets.name: Admin Block
assets.description: Central administrative headquarters housing the registration, accounts, principal offices, and board rooms.

assets.name: Arts & Science Block
assets.description: Academic block for the Arts & Science departments, with smart classrooms and natural ventilation design.

assets.name: Engineering Block
assets.description: Main engineering block with computing centers, electronics labs, lecture halls, and rooftop solar array setup.

assets.name: Main Canteen
assets.description: Primary food court serving the students and staff. Features a newly installed biogas generator for food waste.

assets.name: Ground
assets.description: Multi-sport athletic field for football, cricket, and running. Irrigated using treated STP recycled water.

assets.name: Parking
assets.description: Student and staff vehicle parking area, complete with 4 EV charging stations and solar shade canopies.

assets.name: Nursing Block
assets.description: Indra Ganesan College of Nursing building, equipped with clinical simulation labs and advanced classrooms.

assets.name: Mechanical Lab
assets.description: Mechanical engineering workshop containing lathe machines, welding stations, thermal and fluid dynamics setups.

assets.name: Engineering Canteen
assets.description: Cozy campus cafe dedicated to the engineering quadrant, offering snacks and refreshments.

assets.name: Gym
assets.description: Well-equipped physical fitness center with smart power-saving treadmills and motion-sensor ventilation.

assets.name: Hostel Mess
assets.description: Residential student mess hall. Solid waste is directly routed to the bio-composter unit behind the kitchens.

assets.name: Horticultural Garden
assets.description: Lush experimental agricultural layout with exotic and local flower varieties, managed via rainwater irrigation.

assets.name: Nursery
assets.description: Sapling propagation facility supplying greenery to the entire university and local community.

assets.name: Bus Parking
assets.description: Central depot for the university transport group. Currently optimizing routes using a new smart scheduling system.

assets.name: Dairy Farm
assets.description: Dairy production and research farm holding 45 head of cattle. Highly integrated waste-to-energy circular cycle.

assets.name: Physiotherapy
assets.description: Outpatient rehab clinic focusing on kinesiology, recovery therapy, and physical health, with low impact HVAC.

assets.name: Siddha Medical College & Hospital
assets.description: Siddha system of medicine facility with an active inpatient ward, herbal pharmacy and botanical prep room.

assets.name: Child Park
assets.description: Recreational play space for hospital visitors and group staff children, shaded with 100-year-old banyan trees.

assets.name: Medical Entrance
assets.description: Emergency and general reception plaza of the medical hospital campus, designed with natural day-lighting.

assets.name: Nursing Entrance
assets.description: Welcoming reception courtyard for the Nursing block, flanked by high-density vertical green walls.

assets.name: pharmacy block
assets.description: pharmacy block

reports.title: Water Leakage in Block A
reports.description: Major pipe burst behind the principal office, wasting fresh drinking water.

reports.title: AC Left Switched On
reports.description: Three high-power air conditioners left running in the computer laboratory overnight.

recommendations.title: Solar Canopy Expansion for Bus Parking
recommendations.description: Deploying solar shading panels on Bus Parking would generate an additional 120kW daily, matching the electrical demands of the entire transport fleet maintenance center.

recommendations.title: Greywater Recirculation at Hostel Mess
recommendations.description: The hostel mess has a massive water footprint. Filtering and redirecting kitchen wash water to horticultural drip-lines would save thousands of litres of drinking water per day.

recommendations.title: Biogas Plant feedstock expansion
recommendations.description: Diverting additional organic scrap from the Engineering Canteen to the Main Canteen anaerobic digestor would increase methane yield by 22%, fully replacing LPG cylinder use in student tea-shops.

recommendations.title: Urban Forestry and Carbon Sinks
recommendations.description: Initiate a collaborative tree plantation drive at the periphery of the sports ground and child park to offset transport emissions from buses.
